note: Live-session recording (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded. Passwords are never in this file: the owner types the connection string once when prepare asks (Server=10.50.0.30,1433;Database=master;UID=<login>;<the login's password entry>;Encrypt=yes;TrustServerCertificate=yes); prepare keeps it in the MG_SQL_BASE variable of this session and derives SQL_CONNECTION_STRING for each database; teardown removes both. T-SQL set-up runs on CON-SQL01 over PowerShell Direct as the lab Administrator with Windows authentication (SQL Server's own sysadmin group is Domain Admins). Episode login: lab_demo on both instances (same login and secret on CON-SQL01 and CON-SQL02), made sysadmin for this episode only. The cluster is built by src/ps/Prepare-AgCluster.ps1 run on CON-SQL01 over PowerShell Direct; if the cluster or Test-Cluster steps refuse to work through PowerShell Direct (no delegation), run that script on CON-SQL01's console as the lab Administrator instead.
prepare: Get-VM CON-SQL01, CON-SQL02 | Where-Object State -ne 'Running' | ForEach-Object { Start-VM -VM $_; Start-Sleep -Seconds 60 }

$sql = { param($vm, $text) Invoke-Command -VMName $vm -Credential $cred -ArgumentList $text -ScriptBlock { param($t) $c = New-Object System.Data.SqlClient.SqlConnection 'Server=localhost;Integrated Security=SSPI;TrustServerCertificate=True'; $c.Open(); try { foreach ($b in ($t -split '(?im)^\s*GO\s*$')) { if ($b.Trim()) { $m = $c.CreateCommand(); $m.CommandText = $b; $m.CommandTimeout = 600; [void]$m.ExecuteNonQuery() } } } finally { $c.Close() } } }
& $sql 'CON-SQL01' "IF SUSER_ID(N'lab_demo') IS NULL THROW 50000, N'Create the login lab_demo first (episode 3 demo.md, setup step 3; owner types its password off camera).', 1;"
& $sql 'CON-SQL02' "IF SUSER_ID(N'lab_demo') IS NULL THROW 50000, N'Create the login lab_demo on CON-SQL02 too (same as episode 3, off camera).', 1;"
& $sql 'CON-SQL01' "IF IS_SRVROLEMEMBER(N'sysadmin', N'lab_demo') = 0 ALTER SERVER ROLE sysadmin ADD MEMBER lab_demo;"
& $sql 'CON-SQL02' "IF IS_SRVROLEMEMBER(N'sysadmin', N'lab_demo') = 0 ALTER SERVER ROLE sysadmin ADD MEMBER lab_demo;"
Invoke-Command -Session $s { if (-not (Get-Module -ListAvailable SqlServer)) { Install-PackageProvider NuGet -Force | Out-Null; Install-Module SqlServer -Force -Scope AllUsers -AllowClobber } }

if (-not (Invoke-Command -Session $s { Get-Service ClusSvc -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object Status -eq 'Running' })) { Invoke-Command -Session $s -ArgumentList $cred { param($c) $PSDefaultParameterValues['Invoke-Command:Credential'] = $c; & C:\lab\ep10\ps\Prepare-AgCluster.ps1 } }
if (-not $env:MG_SQL_BASE) { $env:MG_SQL_BASE = Read-Host 'Connection string for lab_demo on 10.50.0.30,1433 (typed off camera, never saved; format in the note of record.json)' -MaskInput }

teardown: $sql = { param($vm, $text) Invoke-Command -VMName $vm -Credential $cred -ArgumentList $text -ScriptBlock { param($t) $c = New-Object System.Data.SqlClient.SqlConnection 'Server=localhost;Integrated Security=SSPI;TrustServerCertificate=True'; $c.Open(); try { foreach ($b in ($t -split '(?im)^\s*GO\s*$')) { if ($b.Trim()) { $m = $c.CreateCommand(); $m.CommandText = $b; $m.CommandTimeout = 600; [void]$m.ExecuteNonQuery() } } } finally { $c.Close() } } }
if (-not $env:MG_SQL_BASE) { $env:MG_SQL_BASE = Read-Host 'Connection string for lab_demo on 10.50.0.30,1433 (typed off camera, never saved; format in the note of record.json)' -MaskInput }

Invoke-Command -VMName CON-SQL01 -Credential $cred { $c = New-Object System.Data.SqlClient.SqlConnection 'Server=localhost;Integrated Security=SSPI;TrustServerCertificate=True'; $c.Open(); $m = $c.CreateCommand(); $m.CommandText = "SELECT CONCAT(CONVERT(nvarchar(260), SERVERPROPERTY('InstanceDefaultBackupPath')), '|', CONVERT(nvarchar(260), SERVERPROPERTY('InstanceDefaultDataPath')), '|', CONVERT(nvarchar(260), SERVERPROPERTY('InstanceDefaultLogPath')))"; $dirs = "$($m.ExecuteScalar())" -split '\|'; $c.Close(); foreach ($d in $dirs) { if ($d) { foreach ($p in 'MGLab_ContosoBikesAG_*') { Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $d -Filter $p -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Remove-Item -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } } } }
& $sql 'CON-SQL01' "IF SUSER_ID(N'CONTOSO\CON-SQL02$') IS NOT NULL DROP LOGIN [CONTOSO\CON-SQL02$];"
& $sql 'CON-SQL02' "IF SUSER_ID(N'CONTOSO\CON-SQL01$') IS NOT NULL DROP LOGIN [CONTOSO\CON-SQL01$];"
& $sql 'CON-SQL01' "IF IS_SRVROLEMEMBER(N'sysadmin', N'lab_demo') = 1 ALTER SERVER ROLE sysadmin DROP MEMBER lab_demo;"
& $sql 'CON-SQL02' "IF IS_SRVROLEMEMBER(N'sysadmin', N'lab_demo') = 1 ALTER SERVER ROLE sysadmin DROP MEMBER lab_demo;"
